text: 1.Be in good Health 2.Non-Chinese citizen 3.applicant should be less than 45 4.Bachelor's degree holder or above 5.English Proficiency 6.TOEFL or IELTS minimum requirements is 550 points or above for TOEFL, and a grade 6.0 or above for IELTS, or other certificate of English proficiency from an approved test. Native English speakers are exempt from this requirement;other candidates whose University courses are taught in English will be considered case by case. Professional Backgrounds 7.Applicants with relevant professional experience or other qualifications deemed appropriciate to the programme applied for may also be considered.
